column1: # Disputes settled by hand (PROTOCOL.md §2: no majority votes). When systems of one regime
# report different answer counts for a query, the item stays "disputed" in every reader
# until a line here gives the correct count and why; then systems with that count are
# undisputed and the others' rows count as wrong. Columns, tab-separated:

column5: SELECT ?s ?label over the one pattern ?s rdfs:label ?label returns one row per triple; olympics.nt (frozen, benches/datasets.toml) holds 137,026 distinct rdfs:label triples (grep | sort -u | wc -l, 3 Oct 2026). Virtuoso returns 42 more.
